notes.title: Whose voices are heard in the project
notes.content:
True Thief is an atmospheric isometric stealth-RPG about the art of survival without violence. No killing - only stealth, agility and the ability to manipulate circumstances. The player will have to find out what happened in this world, what is "Darkness" and how to get out of a difficult situation, in which the main character - Envet Nokt - got into.

Today we want to tell you whose voices bring characters to life in the demo version. Previously, we recorded voice-overs directly with the actors, with no centralized control, so the voices could vary in timbre and intonation.

It's different now. We're working with AniDub Online, and the process is managed by the voice director Eugene Semyonov. Together we have recorded full voice-overs of key characters for Early Access.

Who will you hear in our project?
The main character is Envet Nokt
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/1e6cba03f5db3e4a05d6679c8b7257d4a2fdef8d.jpg
Envet is an experienced thief and a refugee from Mirgard, who caught the beginning of the end. He was able to escape to the capital to start his journey anew, but fate has pushed him back onto the path of thievery. Where will this path lead him to?
🎙 Voiced by Arslanov Timur - the voice of Tanjiro in "The Blade that Splits Demons", Axel in "Lazarus" and many others.

Baron - Longrim Borg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/316a38552cb0016ad4cf40ab2e2edfc99722a7d9.jpg
The enigmatic and influential Baron L., who influenced Enweth's fate by simply kicking him out of his own house and housing his own spy. Whether we meet him is for our player to find out.
🎙 Voiced by Sharafutdinov Damir - the voice of Corkus in "Berserk", Amory in "Stalcraft", etc.

Refugee - Milta
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/67a244d1d2939155a474a97526a81c1ecf2772ba.jpg
A daring, demanding and ambitious girl. From her first day in the capital city of Orlund, she has done everything in order to get into the central quarter and get out of the slums.
🎙 Voiced by Dorofeeva Ekaterina - the official voice of the YouTube channel with 80 million subscribers. Also: Lara in "A Place in the Sun," Jerietta in "Stop Being a Hero."

The undertaker - Miles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/7ef29799e4d2def777d3e7073b753c8465db9a58.jpg
An enterprising old dodger who likes to drink and be always in fashion. Many wonder where he gets the money for it. It is up to our player to figure it out.
🎙 Voiced by Sokolov Alexander - rapper J-Zuss in "Not for Broadcast", Talos Rucker in "Deus Ex: Mankind Divided".

The harbor master is Robert
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/2578dec5b479c3c0e48da8bf695f40ca343a3d45.jpg
Nothing gets past the local jack-of-all-trades Robert in Orlund. He's a real businessman and knows anything and everything. Enveth has to face him, but how will it end....
🎙 Voiced by Maslov Andrew - Scorpio in "Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man", Max in "The Callisto Protocol".

Enchantress - Aria
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/aeb90cae4b7241bf8cbab941529994337affd20a.jpg
The proud and powerful Aria, Orlund's court sorceress.
🎙 Voiced by Zagorskaya Tatiana - Anya Forger "Spy Family", Fern "Friren" and many other familiar characters.

We really hope you enjoy the way the characters of the True Thief world sound. This is an important step for us - and your support makes it even more meaningful.

notes.title: True Thief: mechanics and plot
notes.content:
True Thief is an isometric stealth-role-playing game on Unreal Engine 5. The player will have to think over his every move, hide and bypass the guards.

Game mechanics
Breaking locks by passing puzzles. It will be necessary to act as a real medieval thief, not an assassin. True Thief will force the player to be attentive. Memorize every move of the enemies and the terrain. The game will not have a map to help navigate - the player will have to train his memory. The game will not forgive mistakes and will make you return to the save point and go through again, looking for new ways to bypass to achieve your goals.

As you might have guessed, the game is story-oriented and designed for a single player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/94488f2d80d656871d1169d89071f759c3015b3f.jpg

What's the storyline?
The Middle Ages. You have to play as a guy who stepped on the path of thievery. He had no other way to survive in a rotten world.

You will start playing as a ragamuffin from the slums, breaking into houses with a rusty knife, gradually acquiring uniforms and tools for more complex and protected houses.

We will tell a story full of secrets, riddles, mysticism and horror. What trials await our hero? How did he lose everything? And what will his fate lead to? All this and much more, you will find out while passing True Thief.

The genre of the game is, first of all, a puzzle game. The main mechanics is lock picking, will be presented in the form of a puzzle game with procedural generation. Find all the secrets of the lock to open it and break into the house. Next, steal and collect everything that lies bad 🤗
